definitions.explanation: A cow raised primarily for milk production, as opposed to beef cattle.

examples.japanese: {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take care of dairy cows.

examples.english: This farm raises about one hundred dairy cows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心地|ちゅうしんち}→中心地：03120_chuushinchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生乳|せいにゅう}→生乳：24372_seinyuu⟧{生産量|せいさんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Hokkaido is the center of dairy farming in Japan, accounting for half of the country's raw milk production.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{乳|にゅう}→乳：28296_nyuu⟧ (milk) and {牛|ぎゅう} (cow, cattle). The most common breed in Japan is the Holstein, recognizable by its black-and-white pattern.

Hokkaido is Japan's dairy heartland, producing over half of the nation's milk. Dairy farming is a major part of Hokkaido's identity and economy.
